description: Additional detailed Coding Procedure is unavailable. Local/day objects and national days must not be summed as official unique episodes.
required_followup: Obtain the missing procedure, review national coordination and phase/continuity relationships, then decide official episode units.

description: Official machine-readable baseline comparison is pending; original IDs and earlier decisions remain untouched.
required_followup: Compare review candidates with official baseline before accepting any addition.

description: Open web search is not LexisNexis or a systematic Greek newspaper archive. No inference of exhaustive month coverage or absence of unseen actions.
required_followup: Follow up with systematic archives and regional sources before any completeness claim.

description: Verified actions lack an explicit or clearly qualifying >=50 crowd estimate. Dozens is not automatically >=50; vehicles, stewards, organizations and affected families are not crowd.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous city/action-specific crowd evidence; otherwise retain pending threshold.

description: Planned calls and search-only/blocked reports do not verify executed physical assemblies. Starts remain null.
required_followup: Read accessible contemporary retrospective reports or organizer execution reports, then establish physical onset and size.

description: Only January 29 Thessaloniki closure is explicit. Other physical ends remain unknown; brief blockades and publication dates are not end dates.
required_followup: Find explicit physical dispersal/closure and continuity evidence; keep unknown until verified.

description: Most of seven response categories lack specific evidence. Silence, police presence, broad government refusal and motivating incarceration do not establish coded responses.
required_followup: Seek event-specific police/rights/medical reports without transferring responses across cities or dates.

description: ANSAmed dated January 28 says Friday, although January 28 was Thursday. Kathimerini independently anchors Athens Thursday; Thessaloniki needs its own corroboration. Thessaloniki start is retained at month precision, not silently assigned from Athens.
required_followup: Find a city-specific January 28 Thessaloniki report and preserve source wording/conflict.

description: Search/earlier archive excerpts suggest organizer estimates above the police figure for the late-January Athens action. Exact entry-date linkage was not fully inspected; do not add an unverified 5000 estimate.
required_followup: Read a dated original organizer report. If matched, preserve attributed estimates and retain the lower contemporaneous police estimate around 4000.

description: Lusa headline may suggest tear gas in Athens, while body explicitly locates the hundreds dispersed in Thessaloniki.
required_followup: Retain city-specific body attribution; investigate Athens only with its own evidence.

description: Hunger strike begins January 8 in movement statements versus January 10 in News24/7; neither is the public solidarity assembly start. January 19/29 national-day and city relations remain unresolved.
required_followup: Verify public action phases and national coordination; do not use prisoner hunger-strike onset as public assembly onset.

description: December 30 and January 7 collective-agreement actions share a campaign. No evidence establishes uninterrupted assembly; December 23 dancer-contract issue differs.
required_followup: Review C001/C002 and earlier ministry actions before merging or assigning official episode ownership.

description: Access restrictions were respected: eKathimerini January 14, Magnesia, Logotypos, Proini and TheNewspaper returned 403; ORM returned 406.
required_followup: Use lawful alternate contemporary sources or accessible archives; no bypass. Search titles remain discovered_title, verified title null.

description: AP relay, Lusa relay, ANA–MPA quotes, local Foni tou Nestou relay and alternate infolibre hosts are not independent copies.
required_followup: Trace original origins and seek truly independent witnesses when resolving conflicts.

description: POEDIN January 28 is a national day; only two Thessaloniki hospital locations are body-verified here. Other hospitals are not automatically separate episodes or absent.
required_followup: Establish national coordination, all verified locations and attendance aggregation under the missing procedure.

description: Queries covered English/Greek weekly windows, hospital/labor/culture, rural/hunting, anti-racism/migration, islands and environmental leads. Eastern Aegean refugee actions, small municipalities, first-week labor and environmental groups remain thinly documented.
required_followup: Continue focused regional and sector searches; no claim that these sectors had no protests.

description: Photographs, embedded video and discovered PDFs were not counted or read as full articles. Tool output truncation limited an earlier Volos reader; its body is not relied on.
required_followup: Inspect lawful original media/selected PDF pages where material; do not infer attendance from unseen content.

description: Search results were pooled across four-query batches because the tool did not expose reliable per-query attribution. Initial truncated output preserved only visibly returned relevant URLs; later batches preserve all returned discovery cards, including noise.
required_followup: Use logged batch attribution and limitations; rerun initial topics if retrieval completeness is needed.

description: POTHA annual/monthly, Antigeitonies and KavalaNews tag pages are moving archives. Entry dates were read, but archive page itself may have no single publication date.
required_followup: Locate original permalinks and preserve verified entry dates and origin; do not label a changing archive as a dated single article.
